info.title: Wegz Super Admin API
info.description:
Central Super Admin API for Wegz. Modules: Auth, Admins & Roles/Permissions, Sections, Clients (with Plesk provisioning), Sales, Payments, Operation Reports, Financial Reports, Dashboard, Diagnostics, Audit, and Tenant endpoints.

There are no Packages or Subscriptions. Clients are assigned one or more Sections (hero, header, footer, ...). Tenant databases are created on the Plesk server MongoDB (PLESK_MONGO_URI).

All admin endpoints require a JWT Bearer token. Tenant endpoints require the X-Tenant-Api-Key header.

Super admins can be granted permissions in two ways: a named Role (permission template such as "cashier") or custom per-admin permissions. Role permissions are resolved live on every request.

post.description: Requires admins:add. Pass role_id to grant the role permissions (live). Without role_id the admin starts with no permissions and can be given custom permissions via PUT /api/admin/admins/{id}/permissions.

post.summary: Create a client and start provisioning
post.description: Creates the client record and starts provisioning in the background: creates the tenant DB on Plesk MongoDB, subdomains, deploys builds, generates the tenant API key, writes the tenant .env, and installs SSL. Returns 202 immediately. Poll GET /api/admin/clients/{id}/provisioning-status.

example.message: Client created. Provisioning will start shortly.

patch.description: The subdomain cannot be changed. sections is an array of section ids that replaces the client's assigned sections. Password is hashed on save.

delete.description: Removes the Client document and deactivates its API keys. Does not delete Plesk subdomains, files, or the database. Use DELETE /full for a complete removal.

post.description: Runs the provisioning job (tenant DB, subdomains, files, API key, backend .env) as a detached Plesk scheduled task so it survives the web-server restart. Requires the provisioning:add permission.

Requires clients:edit. Revokes every active key of the client and returns a new raw key. The raw key is shown only once (only its hash is stored), so copy it into the tenant backend .env as SUPER_SYSTEGO_API_KEY and restart the tenant backend — otherwise that tenant's server-to-server calls start returning 401.

example.message: API key regenerated. Store it now, it will not be shown again.

post.description: Runs scripts/migrate-to-plesk.cjs with SOURCE_MONGO_URI. Requires a root admin and MIGRATION_ENABLED=true. The source URI is read from SOURCE_MONGO_URI or from a commented `# MONGO_URI=` line in .env.

get.description: Server-to-server call made by the client's own backend, not by the Super Admin frontend. Send the tenant key in X-Tenant-Api-Key (stored on the tenant server as SUPER_SYSTEGO_API_KEY). active is true only when the client status is active. The client can still log in when inactive and submit a payment.

put.description: Requires admins:edit. Permissions are resolved live from the role. Existing custom permissions on the admin are cleared. An admin cannot change their own role.

tenantApiKey.name: X-Tenant-Api-Key
tenantApiKey.description: Per-client server key (sk_...). Generated during provisioning and written to the tenant backend .env as SUPER_SYSTEGO_API_KEY. Only its SHA-256 hash is stored in the Super database, so it cannot be read back. Rotate it with POST /api/admin/clients/{id}/regenerate-api-key and copy the new value into the tenant .env.

role_id.description: Optional role to assign. Permissions are resolved live from the role. Omit to create an admin with custom permissions.
